test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

B 2 : F 6 :: K 11 : O 15 :: R 18 : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Letter and its Place Value**.

B 2 ⇒ Place value of B is 2.

F 6 ⇒ Place value of F is 6.

K 11 ⇒ Place value of K is 11.

O 15 ⇒ Place value of O is 15.

R 18 ⇒ Place value of R is 18.

Similarly,

V 22 ⇒ Place value of V is 22.

So, V 22 is the next similar term.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V 22"**.
